::: {#rem-datasheet}

#### Datasheets for data sets

@gebru2021datasheets propose a matching document for a data set,
a datasheet,
which answers questions about seven topics [@gebru2021datasheets, section 3]:

- why the data set was made;
- what it holds;
- how it was collected;
- how it was cleaned and labelled;
- what it should and should not be used for;
- how it is distributed;
- who maintains it.

A [model card](#def-model-card) can then point to the datasheets of its training and evaluation data.

:::
